title: SSAT Word League
desc: Learn SSAT Upper vocabulary by winning soccer league matches or conquering a fantasy map. 30 questions a match, with SSAT-style scoring.
notes: Armory with painted heroes and gear, six formations, offside rule, parent-configurable penalty duel
tip: Sign in and your progress follows your account. Words you keep missing come back until they become Legend cards.
author: hugo

title: Legend Arena
desc: Pick a fighting type, level up, and battle bots and bosses in the arena.
notes: Champion Arena unlocked for players who beat World 3
tip: Each fighting type levels up on its own. Try them all!
author: hugo

title: Knockout 3D Boxing
desc: Knock out three opponents. Dodge at the last second, then counter for double damage.
tip: Dodge right before a hit for a PERFECT, then punch back for double damage.
author: hugo

title: Ashen Keep
desc: Cut down the undead in a ruined arena at dusk. Survive Wave 3 to open the gate to a village, quests and an endless road.
notes: Big update: survive Wave 3 to open the gate — village shops, quests, endless road, cave raids and new bosses
tip: Rolling makes you invincible for a moment. Use it to escape crowds.
author: hugo

title: Black Hole Survival
desc: A 12-player survival run. Play online with friends or against bots — don’t get pulled into the black hole!
notes: Leaderboard: see the top survivors (wins, KOs, best time) after every match
tip: Press “Play online” to race real players. Empty spots are filled with bots.
author: hugo

title: Event Horizon: Earth Escape
desc: 180 seconds until impact. Fly the last rescue ship and save the escape pods.
notes: Leaderboard: see the top pilots when your run ends (sign in to join)
tip: Drop off 3 or more pods at once to refill your dash and fix your hull. Gold pods are big Arks!
author: hugo

title: Math Space War
desc: Defend your castle across alien planets. Solve math problems to power up your heroes, collect 758 of them, battle a friend 1v1 and climb the leaderboard.
notes: 1v1 shows which side is yours (⭐ ME flag, green circles), mana gauge fills when you solve a quiz, mana bug in 1v1 fixed
controls: Send heroes, upgrade energy, fire the laser
Solve a problem in battle for extra mana
Make a room and share the 4-digit code
tip: Signed in to PlayCraft? You start right away and your progress saves to your account. Wrong answers go to the Mistakes tab — fix them for bonus coins.
author: hugo
